import Mathlib

inductive Color
| Red
| Black
deriving Inhabited, BEq

inductive Node
| Empty : Node
| Tree  (color : Color) (val : Int) (left : Node) (right : Node) : Node
deriving Inhabited

def view (t : Node) : Set Int :=
  match t with
  | Node.Empty => ∅
  | Node.Tree _ v l r => view l ∪ view r ∪ {v}

def is_red (t : Node) : Bool :=
  match t with
  | Node.Tree Color.Red _ _ _ => true
  | _ => false

def get_color (t : Node) : Color :=
  match t with
  | Node.Tree c _ _ _ => c
  | Node.Empty => Color.Black -- Empty nodes are black

def is_bst (t : Node) : Prop :=
  match t with
  | Node.Empty => True
  | Node.Tree _ v l r =>
    (∀ x ∈ view l, x < v) ∧
    is_bst l ∧
    (∀ x ∈ view r, x > v) ∧
    is_bst r

-- Black Height: Returns -1 if invalid
def black_height (t : Node) : Int :=
  match t with
  | Node.Empty => 1
  | Node.Tree c _ l r =>
    let lh := black_height l
    let rh := black_height r
    if lh ≠ -1 ∧ rh ≠ -1 ∧ lh = rh then
      if c == Color.Black then lh + 1 else lh
    else
      -1

def get_left (t : Node) : Option Node :=
  match t with | Node.Tree _ _ l _ => some l | _ => none

def get_right (t : Node) : Option Node :=
  match t with | Node.Tree _ _ _ r => some r | _ => none

def is_not_empty (t : Node) : Prop :=
  match t with | Node.Empty => False | _ => True

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def rotate_right_precond (t : Node) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  match t with
  | Node.Tree _ _ l _ =>
    -- Strictly match Dafny/Verus: Only require Left child to be Red.
    -- The Double-Red context is checked by the caller (insert), not this helper.
    is_red l
  | _ => False
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def rotate_right (t : Node) 
    (h_precond : rotate_right_precond t) : Node :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  match t with
  | Node.Tree c v (Node.Tree Color.Red lv ll lr) r =>
      Node.Tree c lv ll (Node.Tree Color.Red v lr r)
  | _ => t
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def rotate_right_postcond (t : Node) (result : Node)
    (_ : rotate_right_precond t) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  view result = view t ∧
  is_bst t → is_bst result ∧
  match result, t with
  | Node.Tree c' _ _ r', Node.Tree c _ _ _ =>
      -- New root color matches old root color
      c' = c ∧
      -- New right child is Red
      (match r' with
       | Node.Tree Color.Red _ _ _ => True
       | _ => False) ∧
      -- Black height preservation
      (black_height t ≠ -1 → black_height result = black_height t)
  | _, _ => False
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
@[simp]
lemma color_red_beq_black : (Color.Red == Color.Black) = false := rfl

@[simp]
lemma color_black_beq_black : (Color.Black == Color.Black) = true := rfl

lemma is_bst_rotate_right {c : Color} {v lv : Int} {ll lr r : Node} :
    is_bst (Node.Tree c v (Node.Tree Color.Red lv ll lr) r) →
    is_bst (Node.Tree c lv ll (Node.Tree Color.Red v lr r)) := by
  intro h
  change
      (∀ x ∈ view (Node.Tree Color.Red lv ll lr), x < v) ∧
      is_bst (Node.Tree Color.Red lv ll lr) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ view r, x > v) ∧
      is_bst r at h
  rcases h with ⟨hLeftAll, hLeftBst, hRightAll, hRightBst⟩
  change
      (∀ x ∈ view ll, x < lv) ∧
      is_bst ll ∧
      (∀ x ∈ view lr, x > lv) ∧
      is_bst lr at hLeftBst
  rcases hLeftBst with ⟨hLLAll, hLLBst, hLRAll, hLRBst⟩

  have hlv_lt_v : lv < v := by
    apply hLeftAll lv
    simp [view]

  have hlr_lt_v : ∀ x ∈ view lr, x < v := by
    intro x hx
    apply hLeftAll x
    simp [view, hx]

  change
      (∀ x ∈ view ll, x < lv) ∧
      is_bst ll ∧
      (∀ x ∈ view (Node.Tree Color.Red v lr r), x > lv) ∧
      is_bst (Node.Tree Color.Red v lr r)
  refine ⟨hLLAll, hLLBst, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x hx
    have hx' : x = v ∨ x ∈ view lr ∨ x ∈ view r := by
      simpa [view, Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff] using hx
    rcases hx' with hxv | hxlr | hxr
    · subst x
      linarith
    · exact hLRAll x hxlr
    · have hx_gt_v : x > v := hRightAll x hxr
      linarith
  · change
        (∀ x ∈ view lr, x < v) ∧
        is_bst lr ∧
        (∀ x ∈ view r, x > v) ∧
        is_bst r
    exact ⟨hlr_lt_v, hLRBst, hRightAll, hRightBst⟩

lemma black_height_rotate_right {c : Color} {v lv : Int} {ll lr r : Node} :
    black_height (Node.Tree c v (Node.Tree Color.Red lv ll lr) r) ≠ -1 →
    black_height (Node.Tree c lv ll (Node.Tree Color.Red v lr r)) =
      black_height (Node.Tree c v (Node.Tree Color.Red lv ll lr) r) := by
  intro hvalid
  set a : Int := black_height ll with ha
  set b : Int := black_height lr with hb
  set d : Int := black_height r with hd
  by_cases H : a ≠ -1 ∧ b ≠ -1 ∧ a = b
  · by_cases G : a ≠ -1 ∧ d ≠ -1 ∧ a = d
    · have J : b ≠ -1 ∧ d ≠ -1 ∧ b = d := by
        rcases H with ⟨_, hb_ne, hab⟩
        rcases G with ⟨_, hd_ne, had⟩
        exact ⟨hb_ne, hd_ne, hab.symm.trans had⟩
      cases c <;> simp [black_height, ← ha, ← hb, ← hd, H, G, J]
    · have K : ¬ (d ≠ -1 ∧ b = d) := by
        intro hg
        apply G
        rcases H with ⟨ha_ne, _, hab⟩
        rcases hg with ⟨hd_ne, hbd⟩
        exact ⟨ha_ne, hd_ne, hab.trans hbd⟩
      have hbad :
          black_height (Node.Tree c v (Node.Tree Color.Red lv ll lr) r) = -1 := by
        cases c <;> simp [black_height, ← ha, ← hb, ← hd, H, K]
      exact False.elim (hvalid hbad)
  · have hbad :
        black_height (Node.Tree c v (Node.Tree Color.Red lv ll lr) r) = -1 := by
      cases c <;> simp [black_height, ← ha, ← hb, ← hd, H]
    exact False.elim (hvalid hbad)
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem rotate_right_postcond_satisfied (t : Node)
    (h_precond : rotate_right_precond t) :
    rotate_right_postcond t (rotate_right t h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  cases t with
  | Empty =>
      exfalso
      simp [rotate_right_precond] at h_precond
  | Tree c v l r =>
      cases l with
      | Empty =>
          exfalso
          simp [rotate_right_precond, is_red] at h_precond
      | Tree lc lv ll lr =>
          cases lc with
          | Red =>
              change
                (view (Node.Tree c lv ll (Node.Tree Color.Red v lr r)) =
                    view (Node.Tree c v (Node.Tree Color.Red lv ll lr) r) ∧
                  is_bst (Node.Tree c v (Node.Tree Color.Red lv ll lr) r)) →
                  is_bst (Node.Tree c lv ll (Node.Tree Color.Red v lr r)) ∧
                  (c = c ∧ True ∧
                    (black_height (Node.Tree c v (Node.Tree Color.Red lv ll lr) r) ≠ -1 →
                      black_height (Node.Tree c lv ll (Node.Tree Color.Red v lr r)) =
                        black_height (Node.Tree c v (Node.Tree Color.Red lv ll lr) r)))
              intro h
              rcases h with ⟨_, hbst⟩
              refine ⟨is_bst_rotate_right (c := c) (v := v) (lv := lv)
                (ll := ll) (lr := lr) (r := r) hbst, ?_⟩
              exact ⟨rfl, trivial,
                black_height_rotate_right (c := c) (v := v) (lv := lv)
                  (ll := ll) (lr := lr) (r := r)⟩
          | Black =>
              exfalso
              simp [rotate_right_precond, is_red] at h_precond
  -- !benchmark @end proof
